mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees under clear skies with a Full Moon illuminating the Military Ridge State Trail.

City officials remind us that Highway M will undergo a closure from October 5 through October 7 to complete asphalt and shoulder work. Additionally, ongoing utility and road improvements continue for the new Aldi site, maintaining one lane of traffic in each direction.

There is plenty to do in our city, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Later in the week, enjoy the Farmer's Market, more live music, and additional trivia opportunities.

In a noteworthy update, on September 5, officers investigated a string of vehicles with cheese slices placed on their windshields, a viral prank known as the Dairy Dare, though no damage was reported.
Culver's of Verona is featuring the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie today. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
